versions.name: RXV2-0.9.178-tx-governor
versions.notes: Adds GOVERNOR editing from the transmitter (profile + config), RF 2.3+ only. Profile via MSP_GOVERNOR_PROFILE/SET (148/149); config via MSP_GOVERNOR_CONFIG/SET (142/143) followed by an FC reboot so it takes effect (like V1). Completes full Rotorflight parity from the handset: rates, advanced rates, PIDs, advanced PIDs, governor - all readable and writable from the TX as well as the iPhone.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.177-adv-pid
versions.notes: Adds ADVANCED PID editing from the transmitter (read + write): the full Dynamics/bandwidth/cutoff/limit set (26 values) via MSP_PID_PROFILE / MSP_SET_PID_PROFILE, mapped through the scattered profile offsets. Read-modify-write preserves untouched fields. That is rates, advanced rates, PIDs and advanced PIDs all editable from the handset - governor next.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.176-timing
versions.notes: Reduces the occasional all-zeros when reading params from the transmitter. Removed the post-write cache blanking (the re-poll refreshes the saved values anyway), tightened the FC re-poll to ~50ms (was 80ms, matching V1), and shortened the stuck-fetch retry from 400ms to 250ms. Any remaining rare zeros are a dropped request packet from the TX (re-trigger to fix).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.175-adv-preserve
versions.notes: Fix: saving ADVANCED rates from the transmitter no longer zeroes that bank's BASIC rates (and vice-versa). Each rates screen now writes only its own fields via read-modify-write; the other fields are preserved from the FC. Previously the advanced save also wrote the basic-rate fields from staged values that could be zero (e.g. a lost batch packet), clobbering the bank.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.174-tx-pids
versions.notes: Adds PID editing from the transmitter (read + write). 17 PID values (P/I/D/FF per axis, boosts, HSI offsets) read via MSP_PID and written via MSP_SET_PID, using the same continuous-re-poll engine as rates. Governor next.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.173-adv-fix
versions.notes: Fixes the advanced-rates setpoint boost gain/cutoff scramble on the transmitter. The MSP RC_TUNING boost tail is interleaved per axis (Roll gain, Roll cutoff, Pitch gain, Pitch cutoff ...), not grouped - corrected both the read (TX now shows the Configurator values) and the write-back.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.172-adv-rates
versions.notes: Adds ADVANCED RATES editing from the transmitter (response time, setpoint-boost gain/cutoff, yaw dynamics), and fixes the intermittent all-zeros on bank switch. Like V1, the receiver now RE-POLLS the flight-controller continuously (~80ms) while the transmitter is reading a rates block, so a bank change or a single missed MSP round-trip no longer leaves the TX reading zeros. Rates + advanced are written together (combined MSP_SET_RC_TUNING) preserving untouched fields.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.171-rfver
versions.notes: Fixes the rate FACTORS shown on the transmitter. Ack slot 31 now reports the real Rotorflight version (1 = RF2.2, 2 = RF2.3) instead of a flat 1, so the TX picks the correct 2.3 factor table - rates now read exactly as the Configurator (Roll 160/20/20, Yaw 400/20/20, Collective 6.0/48/0) instead of the 2.2-scaled 320/200/0.20. Also relabels the TX columns to Rate/Shape/Expo on 2.3.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.170-tx-rates
versions.notes: NEW: edit Rotorflight RATES from the transmitter (not just the iPhone). A V1-compatible transmitter can now read and set the rate values over the radio link - the receiver fetches/writes them to the flight-controller over MSP. Built on a new non-blocking parameter engine (TxParams.h) ported byte-exact from V1, so it never stalls the RC link. RATES first; PIDs and governor to follow. iPhone editing unchanged.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.169-nocache-js
versions.notes: Fixed stale-UI-after-update: app.js and style.css were cached by the browser for a whole day (max-age=86400), so a freshly-updated page could call helpers the old cached app.js did not have yet (e.g. the new Save-confirmation box silently did nothing). They now revalidate every load like the HTML pages do. NOTE: after THIS update do one hard-refresh (Cmd/Ctrl-Shift-R) to clear the previously-cached app.js; subsequent UI updates take effect immediately.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.168-gear-msg
versions.notes: Save gear ratio now pops a confirmation box ("Gear ratio = <n> saved!") instead of only a quiet status line. Added a shared single-button LDRC.alert() helper for tidy acknowledgements.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.167-fs-crsf
versions.notes: Failsafe now defers to the flight-controller on CRSF. A Rotorflight FC overrules receiver-streamed channels on signal loss (its own failsafe is the authority over CRSF), so on CRSF the receiver no longer streams the saved failsafe - it lets the FC take over (configure it in Rotorflight's Failsafe tab). The saved failsafe is KEPT and still applied on signal loss for SBUS / FBUS / IBUS / PPM models that rely on it. No-transmitter boot is still always disarmed-safe.
